Bill.BriefDescription: Creating an interdisciplinary work group with faculty from a paramedic training program and an associate degree nursing program.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to an interdisciplinary work group with facultyfrom a paramedic training program and an associate degree in nursingprogram; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The state board for community and technicalcolleges shall identify a community or technical college that offersboth a paramedic training program and an associate degree in nursingprogram to create an interdisciplinary work group with faculty fromeach program. The work group shall review the training and curriculumof both programs to establish a set of recognized course equivalenciesor skill competencies between the programs. The work group shallreport its findings and any recommendations to the board by December 1,2009. The board may use the findings and recommendations as the basisfor any statewide policies regarding articulation between paramedictraining programs and nursing programs.
